instruction: Take off all quantities for the manhole and pipe drainage system

given_data.cover_depth: 50mm from top of MH to GL
given_data.step_bars: 12mm mild steel step bars at 300mm c/c
given_data.cover_and_frame: 600 x 450 medium duty Gulvanised iron cover frame
given_data.slab: 100mm thick slab reinforced with 8mm diameter bars of 100mmm c/c both ways

query_sheet.question: What is the invert depth at WC and gully trap — not stated in drawing?
query_sheet.impact: Needed to calculate average trench depth for WC-MH1 and GT-MH2 pipe runs

query_sheet.question: What is the spacing of step irons — not specified?
query_sheet.impact: Used to calculate number of step irons in manholes exceeding 1000mm deep

phases.phase_name: Phase 1 — establish invert levels and total depths
phases.phase_purpose: All manhole pit sizes and pipe trench depths depend on these values first

steps.heading: MH1 external dimensions
steps.thought: I need the external pit size for excavation and to find the clear wall height later
steps.feeds_into: Excavation pit dimensions, mean girth calculation

steps.heading: MH1 total depth
steps.thought: Total depth = invert depth + base concrete + channel allowance + cover depth
steps.formula: Total depth = Invert + base + channel + cover
steps.feeds_into: Excavation depth, wall height, trench depth calculation

steps.heading: MH2 external dimensions
steps.thought: MH2 is circular — external diameter adds two wall thicknesses
steps.formula: External dia = Internal dia + 2 x wall_thickness
steps.feeds_into: Excavation pit area, circumference for walling

steps.heading: MH2 invert depth and total depth
steps.thought: Clear distance between manholes (c/c minus half each external dimension) gives the fall
steps.formula: x = c/c - (ext_MH1_L/2) - (ext_MH2_dia/2) | Dy = x/40 | D2 = D1 + Dy | Total = D2 + base + channel + cover
steps.feeds_into: Excavation, wall height, pipe trench avg depth

steps.heading: MH3 external dimensions
steps.thought: Rectangular manhole — same formula as MH1

steps.heading: MH3 invert depth and total depth
steps.thought: Same process as MH2 — clear distance MH2-MH3 then apply gradient
steps.formula: x = c/c - (ext_MH2_dia/2) - (ext_MH3_L/2) | Dy = x/40 | D3 = D2 + Dy | Total = D3 + base + channel + cover
steps.result: MH3 invert = 1428.75mm | MH3 total depth = 1678.75mm | Stage 1 (≤1500mm) = 1500mm | Stage 2 (>1500mm) = 1678.75 - 1500 = 178.75mm
steps.feeds_into: Two-stage excavation, two-stage walling, step irons

phases.phase_purpose: Work through each manhole component, calculate values, then book to dimension paper

steps.heading: Excavation — pits to receive manholes
steps.thought: SMM7 D20: pits measured in m³ by depth band (≤1500mm and >1500mm separately). MH1 and MH2 both within 1500mm so grouped. MH3 splits into two stages.
steps.formula: Vol = L x W x H (rectangular) | Vol = (π/4 x D²) x H (circular)

entries.grouping_reason: MH1 (850mm) and MH2 (1041mm) both within same depth band — same SMM7 item, stacked under one description

rows.label: MH2 — circular area formula in B column

entries.description: Excavate pits to receive manholes; maximum depth not exceeding 1500mm; commencing at ground level; cut away and remove spoil

entries.grouping_reason: MH3 stage 1 has same description as above — use Ditto
Different SMM7 depth band — must be a separate item always
entries.description: Ditto but exceeding 1500mm deep; not exceeding 3000mm; commencing 1500mm below ground level; cut away and remove spoil

steps.heading: Planking, strutting and dewatering
steps.thought: No measurable dimension — SMM7 requires this as a lump-sum provisional allowance. Nr = Item.

entries.grouping_reason: Single lump-sum allowance covers all manholes and trenches
entries.description: Allow for necessary planking and strutting to sides of all excavations and for dewatering

steps.heading: Concrete beds to manholes
steps.thought: Beds measured in m² (plan area) with thickness in the description. All three manholes same mix and thickness — group under one description.
steps.formula: Area = L x W (rectangular) | Area = π/4 x D² (circular)
steps.result: Three rows grouped under one description

entries.grouping_reason: All three manholes share same mix (1:3:6) and same 150mm thickness — one description, three dimension rows stacked

rows.label: MH1 — plan area only, H not used

entries.description: Plain in-situ mass concrete (1:3:6); 150mm thick bed to manholes

steps.heading: Stone walling — calculate mean girth and wall height first
steps.thought: Walling measured as area (mean girth x height). Each manhole has different girth and height so separate rows, but same description — group them.
steps.formula: Mean girth (rect) = 2(L + W) - 4 x wall_thickness | Mean girth (circ) = π x mean_dia | Wall height = Invert_depth - slab_thickness + channel_allowance

entries.grouping_reason: Same material, same thickness, same mortar mix — different dimensions only. Three rows grouped under one description.

rows.label: MH1 — mean girth x wall height
MH2 — circumference of mean diameter x height
MH3 — mean girth x wall height

entries.description: 150mm thick stone walling to manholes; bedded and jointed in cement and sand mortar (1:3); including all curved work

steps.heading: Step irons — query Q2 applied
steps.thought: Only manholes exceeding 1000mm deep need step irons. MH1=850mm (excluded). MH2=1041mm (included). MH3=1678mm (included). Using Q2 assumption: 300mm spacing.
steps.result: MH2 = 3 Nr | MH3 = 5 Nr | Total = 8 Nr

entries.grouping_reason: Same item both manholes — Nr values added, one description. MH1 excluded (depth <1000mm).
entries.description: Mild steel step iron; fish-tailed both ends; twice bent at right angles; built in and set in cement mortar

steps.heading: Cover slab and GI cover and frame
steps.thought: Cover slab measured as Nr — each manhole gets one slab and one cover/frame. All same GI cover size (600x450) but different slab sizes — separate Ditto items for slabs, one grouped item for frames.
steps.result: 3 Nr slabs (described individually with Ditto) | 3 Nr covers and frames (T=3)

entries.grouping_reason: Different slab sizes for each manhole — cannot group, use Ditto for subsequent ones
entries.description: Precast concrete cover slab; 1200 x 900 x 100mm thick; reinforced with A193 mesh; opening 600 x 450mm

entries.grouping_reason: Ditto with only the size difference stated
entries.description: Ditto but 1500mm diameter x 100mm thick; opening 600 x 450mm

entries.grouping_reason: Ditto with only the size difference stated
entries.description: Ditto but 1500 x 1200 x 100mm thick; opening 600 x 450mm

entries.group_label: GI cover and frame — all manholes
entries.grouping_reason: All three manholes have identical 600x450mm GI cover and frame — T=3 times one item

rows.label: T=3 because all three manholes identical cover — T column used here not Nr

entries.description: 600 x 450mm galvanised iron manhole cover and frame; set in cement mortar (1:3)

phases.phase_purpose: Calculate average trench depths, pipe lengths, then book excavation and pipe laying

steps.heading: Average trench depth WC to MH1 — uses Q1
steps.thought: uPVC pipes laid directly on ground (no bed). Average depth = (depth at start + depth at end) / 2. Depth at pipe = invert depth of manhole (not total depth).
steps.formula: MH invert depth = Total_depth - base - channel | Avg depth = (start_depth + end_depth) / 2
steps.working: MH1 invert depth = 850 - 150 - 50 = 650mm (wait — invert IS 600mm from given data, use 600mm) | Avg = (300 + 600) / 2 = 450mm
steps.result: Average depth WC to MH1 = 450mm — not exceeding 1500mm

entries.grouping_reason: Unique pipe size and unique average depth — standalone item

rows.label: B = trench length c/c WC to MH1; linear item so S and H not used

entries.description: Excavate trench; average depth 450mm; not exceeding 1500mm deep; to receive 50mm diameter uPVC pipe; cut away and remove spoil

steps.heading: Pipe laying — 50mm uPVC WC to MH1
steps.thought: Pipe length = trench length (c/c). uPVC pipes laid directly on ground — no bed item needed.

entries.grouping_reason: Unique diameter — separate item. GT to MH2 also 50mm so that will be Ditto

rows.label: B = pipe length in metres; linear item

entries.description: 50mm diameter uPVC pipe; laid and jointed in trenches
